name: opencode-orchestrator
description: Multi-agent orchestration and visualization foundations for OpenCode V2.

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts src/tui.ts --outdir dist --target bun --format esm --external @opencode/plugin --external @opencode/plugin/tui
scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run build
scripts.format: biome format --write src scripts test server.ts tui.ts package.json tsconfig.json biome.json opencode.jsonc examples
scripts.format:check: biome format src scripts test server.ts tui.ts package.json tsconfig.json biome.json opencode.jsonc examples
